description: Description Using PBIVizEdit SPC Attribute Control Chart (Pro) you can create: p chart for proportion of defects. np chart for number of defects. c chart for defect count per item. u chart for defects per unit. Laney p’/u’ charts for over dispersed data. G chart for units between rare events. T chart for time between rare events. Features available with PBIVizEdit SPC Attribute Control Chart (Pro) Laney charts for handling overdispersion. Detect patterns like ascending, descending, above/below mean, zigzag, and run length violations. Custom upper- and lower-line data type and aggregation like mean, median, standard deviation etc. Show standard deviation lines as reference points for variation Custom axis and label formatting and marker styles. Customizable control limits and centre lines.
